verses.english: Linked Discourses 55.12
2. The Royal Monastery
The Brahmins
At Sāvatthī.
“Mendicants, the brahmins advocate a practice called ‘get up and go’.
They encourage their disciples:

verses.pali: ‘ehi tvaṁ, ambho purisa, kālasseva uṭṭhāya pācīnamukho yāhi.
verses.english: ‘Please, good people, rising early you should face east and walk.

verses.pali: So tvaṁ mā sobbhaṁ parivajjehi, mā papātaṁ, mā khāṇuṁ, mā kaṇḍakaṭhānaṁ, mā candaniyaṁ, mā oḷigallaṁ.
verses.english: Do not avoid a pit, a cliff, a stump, thorny ground, a swamp, or a sewer.
You should await death in the place that you fall.

verses.pali: Evaṁ tvaṁ, ambho purisa, kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjissasī’ti.
verses.english: And when your body breaks up, after death, you’ll be reborn in a good place, a heaven realm.’

verses.pali: Taṁ kho panetaṁ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇānaṁ bālagamanametaṁ mūḷhagamanametaṁ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: But this practice of the brahmins is a foolish procedure, a stupid procedure. It doesn’t lead to disillusionment, dispassion, cessation, peace, insight, awakening, or extinguishment.

verses.pali: Ahañca kho, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye udayagāminiṁ paṭipadaṁ paññāpemi;
verses.english: But in the training of the Noble One I advocate a ‘get up and go’ practice

verses.pali: yā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: which does lead solely to disillusionment, dispassion, cessation, peace, insight, awakening, and extinguishment.

verses.pali: Katamā ca sā, bhikkhave, udayagāminī paṭipadā;
verses.english: And what is that ‘get up and go’ practice?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti—
verses.english: It’s when a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha …

verses.pali: itipi so bhagavā arahaṁ sammāsambuddho …pe… satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavāti;

verses.english: the teaching …
the Saṅgha …

verses.pali: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṁvattanikehi.
verses.english: And they have the ethical conduct loved by the noble ones … leading to immersion.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho sā, bhikkhave, udayagāminī paṭipadā ekantanibbidāya …pe…
verses.english: This is that ‘get up and go’ practice
which does lead solely to disillusionment, dispassion, cessation, peace, insight, awakening, and extinguishment.”
